Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `checkout` in namespace `shop` rolled out revision 2 (change-cause "release v2"), and its container command exits 1 with "FATAL: config file /etc/checkout/config.yaml not found", so pod `checkout-7f6bb97849-n9wh7` crash-loops.

EVIDENCE:
- `rollout_history` (deployment checkout, shop): revisions 1 and 2 both have CHANGE-CAUSE "release v2". Confirmed by my own `rollout_history` call. (diag-k8s, then my check)
- `get` raw replicaset selector app=checkout, shop: ReplicaSet `checkout-7f6bb97849` (revision 2, replicas 1) runs `sh -c "echo checkout v2 starting; echo FATAL: config file /etc/checkout/config.yaml not found >&2; exit 1"`, with no volume or ConfigMap mount for that path. Confirmed by my `describe` of the pod. (diag-k8s)
- `get` raw replicaset selector app=checkout, shop: ReplicaSet `checkout-658d6f85b4` (revision 1, replicas 0) ran `sh -c "echo checkout v1 serving; sleep 36000"` on busybox:1.37 with the same limits. The rollout scaled it to 0. (diag-k8s)
- `describe` pod checkout-7f6bb97849-n9wh7 (shop): container checkout is Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 1, Restart Count 6, Last State exit 1 at 22:36:00 and 22:38:42. Events: Warning BackOff (x8) "Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-7f6bb97849-n9wh7_shop". Confirmed by my own `describe` call. (diag-k8s, then my check)
- `logs` (pod checkout-7f6bb97849-n9wh7, container checkout, shop, previous: true): no log lines returned, only "unable to retrieve container logs for containerd://9c79b0fda37abe24078ad3e067e972212ecdf54b36923091bfd3bc4e0d72d395". The FATAL line comes from the pod command, not from the logs. (diag-k8s)

FIX (not applied): roll back deployment `checkout` in namespace `shop` to revision 1 with `kubectl rollout undo -n shop deploy/checkout --to-revision=1`, or ship /etc/checkout/config.yaml in revision 2.
